id.description: The unique identifier of the booking.

confirmation_code.description: The human-readable confirmation code for the booking.

status.description: The current status of the booking.

experience_id.description: The identifier of the booked experience.

schedule_id.description: The identifier of the booked schedule entry.

guests_count.description: The number of guests included in the booking.

total_price.description: The total price of the booking.

currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency code for the booking pricing.

host_payout.description: The amount to be paid out to the host after fees.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the booking was created.

updated_at.description: The timestamp when the booking was last updated.
